summary: Fixed unreleased migrations 0012 (drop and recreate the elevation index, exact feet-to-metres rounding) and 0013 (generated full_name without concat_ws, which SQLite 3.40 lacks), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (cp1252 for collectors, deferred taxa seed, complete basis map). A clean build succeeds and a 1.6.0 database upgrades to the same schema and rows as a fresh build.
